films.title: The Odyssey
films.synopsis: The Odyssey - In Cinemas 16.07.26 Christopher Nolan’s next film, The Odyssey, is a mythic action epic shot across the world using brand new IMAX® film technology. The film brings Homer’s foundational saga to IMAX® film screens for the first time and opens in cinemas everywhere on July 16, 2026. The Odyssey stars Matt Damon, Tom Holland, Anne Hathaway, Robert Pattinson and Lupita Nyong’o, with Zendaya and Charlize Theron. The Odyssey is produced by Emma Thomas and Christopher Nolan for their company, Syncopy. The executive producer is Thomas Hayslip.

films.title: Hanuman Ansh
films.synopsis: A grieving boy seeks God to meet his departed mother, and in finding the divine, learns to serve humanity with miracles of love, food and silent blessings, becoming Hanuman Ansh, Neem Karoli Baba.

films.title: Haiwaan
films.synopsis: A blind maintenance manager with razor-sharp instincts is falsely accused of murder and theft. Now, he must race against time to protect a young girl from a vengeful killer, while the law and fate close in on him from all sides.

films.title: Bethlehem Kudumba Unit
films.synopsis: Follows a couple with a significant age difference as they navigate their romantic relationship.

films.title: Practical Magic 2
films.synopsis: Practical Magic 2 returns to a world steeped in moonlit mischief and powerful ancestral magic, as the Owens sisters must confront the dark curse that threatens to unravel their family once and for all in a must-see cinematic event of fun, magic and mayhem.

films.title: Fall 2: Deadpoint
films.synopsis: Grieving her sister Shiloh's death, Jax Hunter bonds with Shiloh's bold friend Luce. They tackle Mount Kwan's dangerous plank walk in Thailand. When a rockslide traps them on a narrow plank 3000 feet up, Jax must face her fears to survive.

films.title: Sardar 2
films.synopsis: The film acts as a proper continuation of the original story, expanding into a larger-scale international espionage mission. It follows the protagonist as he tackles new high-stakes threats and sensitive topics.

films.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
films.synopsis: It's a BRAND NEW DAY for Peter Parker. Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn’t remember him -- and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him -- sparks a change in Peter he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

films.title: Coyote VS Acme
films.synopsis: A story set in the ACME warehouse, the manufacturer of anything and everything used by the Looney Tunes characters.

films.title: It Ends
films.synopsis: Friends on a late-night food run become trapped on an infinite highway with otherworldly terrors lurking beyond. Confined in their Jeep Cherokee, they must decide whether to accept their fate or attempt escape.

films.title: Mirzapur
films.synopsis: MIRZAPUR’s throne gives great power to whoever controls it. There are existing players. Akhandanand Tripathi – who sits on it, Munna Tripathi – the heir apparent, Rati Shankar Shukla – the don of Jaunpur. And Guddu and Bablu – the two brothers who arrived like a hurricane and changed the dynamics irreversibly. Forever and then, there is the new claimant who appears in this saga of bloodshed and violence. Babban ‘Babua’ – from the deserts of Jaisalmer, and with a past connection with Mirzapur. A violent and ruthless man whose weapon is a pair of scissors. Mirzapur The Movie showcases this power tussle, splashed with blood and revenge.

films.title: I'm Game
films.synopsis: A fearless gambler who trusts luck more than life gets caught in a series of crazy and unexpected events that turn his world upside down. What follows is a thrilling ride filled with fun, surprises, action, and unforgettable moments.

films.title: Insidious: Out Of The Further
films.synopsis:
Having earned over $740 million at the global box office, the Insidious franchise returns with a new family and a terror that redefines what The Further is capable of.
In Insidious: Out of the Further, Amelia Eve stars as Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in who discovers she can travel into The Further, the purgatorial realm of lost souls at the heart of the Insidious universe. When something evil comes after her, Gemma discovers an ability that changes everything: she doesn’t just enter The Further, she can bring what lives there back to the real world. Once the demons realize her power, our world becomes their playground.

films.title: Awarapan 2
films.synopsis:
Shivam returns to the crime world, where his path forward demands redemption, love, and sacrifice. As relationships deepen and conflicts intensify, 
every choice tests his resolve and shapes his destiny.

films.title: The Dog Stars
films.synopsis: In a post-apocalyptic world, a virus wipes out humanity. Survivors face roaming scavengers called Reapers. Protagonist Hig, a pilot, survived the flu but lost his wife.

films.title: Mutiny
films.synopsis: After his billionaire industrialist boss is murdered in front of him, Cole Reed is set up to take the fall for the crime -- leaving him on the run as he works to uncover an international conspiracy.

films.title: The End of Oak Street
films.synopsis: After a mysterious cosmic event rips Oak Street from suburbia and transports their neighbourhood to someplace unknown, the Platt family soon discovers that their very survival depends on them sticking together as they navigate their now unrecognizable surroundings.

films.title: Minions & Monsters
films.synopsis: This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

films.title: Toy Story 5
films.synopsis: Woody, Buzz, Jessie and the rest of the gang's jobs are challenged when they're introduced to electronics, a new threat to playtime.

films.title: Cats in the Museum
films.synopsis: : A young cat named Vincent, in the company of Maurice the mouse, escapes from the flood in an old harpsichord, which is picked up by sailors and sent to St. Petersburg, where it ends up in the Hermitage. There, Vincent meets an elite feline squad that has been protecting artwork from mice and other pests for centuries. Vincent dreams of finding a real cat family, but does not want to lose his friend Maurice, who saved his life. Vincent has to hide a friend, who also has one "little weakness" - Maurice loves to gnaw on masterpieces of painting. The situation becomes even more complicated when one of the greatest paintings of mankind, the Mona Lisa, arrives in the Hermitage, and it is the dream of all mice to gnaw it. But neither Vincent, nor Maurice, nor the cats of the Hermitage suspect that the painting is going to be stolen. And now Vincent will have to show all his resourcefulness and courage in order to save the masterpiece, protect the honor of the museum and win the love of a cat named Cleopatra from the Egyptian hall.

films.title: Colony
films.synopsis: Professor Se Jeong attends a biotech conference, only to witness it spiral into catastrophe when a rapidly mutating virus is unleashed. As the outbreak spreads and the infected begin to transform, authorities seal off the entire facility.

films.title: El Set Lamma
films.synopsis: In a social comedy setting, the film follows Dina El-Kurdi, a media activist who launches a campaign titled “Women Have the Right to Veto” to combat violence against women. Her campaign intersects with a series of impactful women’s stories, while facing humorous and opposing reactions from some men and society, creating comedic situations mixed with social conflict and highlighting issues of women’s rights and challenging traditional views.

films.title: El Gawahergy
films.synopsis: After being caught one too many times, Seif, a famous jeweler with a weakness for women, is forced to put his traditional male pride aside. When his strong-willed wife Yasmine insists on building a healthier and more balanced life together, the couple turns to a relationship counselor and embarks on an unconventional therapy program to save their marriage. Instead of bringing them closer, each step unleashes a new wave of hilarious chaos, turning their attempt to fix their relationship into a series of escalating disasters.

films.title: Blue Lock
films.synopsis: Follows 300 high school soccer players competing in ruthless trials at a secret training facility, where only one will emerge as the world's greatest striker and the eliminated are banned from Japan's National Team.

films.title: Paw Patrol: The Dino Movie
films.synopsis: After their ship gets caught in a mysterious storm, the PAW Patrol pups crash land on an uncharted tropical island filled with dinosaurs. They meet Rex, a pup who has been stranded on the island for years and has become an expert in all things dino-related. When the PAW Patrol's archrival, Mayor Humdinger, begins recklessly mining in hopes of exploiting the island for its natural resources, he inadvertently causes a huge, dormant volcano to erupt. The PAW Patrol pups are thrown into a series of high-stakes, dino-sized rescues bigger than anything they've done before, as they must stop Humdinger before everything on the island goes extinct.

films.title: Mahmoud El Tany
films.synopsis: When a polished, high-powered businessman and a quick-witted street hustler discover they share the same name, a bizarre twist of fate forces them to swap lives—leading to chaos, comedy, and an unexpected journey of self-discovery.

films.title: By Any Means
films.synopsis:
The FBI couldn’t crack it. So they called in the mob.
Forced to work alongside a notorious mafia hitman, a young Black FBI agent finds himself pulled into a deadly hunt where justice and vengeance begin to blur.

films.title: Cats in the Museum: Treasures of Egypt
films.synopsis: Two years have passed since the Hermitage was saved and the Mona Lisa was stolen. Maurice the mouse dreams of new exploits, Vincent and Cleopatra have acquired two restless kittens and are also longing for adventures.

films.title: Red Flag
films.synopsis: A flight attendant poses as a commercial captain to charm women. When he falls in love with Habiba, he decides to settle down. Due to tight flight shifts, he grants his father a power of attorney to execute the wedding contract—only to end up married to four women simultaneously! When his father suffers temporary amnesia, Hesham embarks on a race against time to untangle the three extra marriages before Habiba discovers the chaos.

films.title: Spider Island
films.synopsis: A bunch of young men and women just want to have some fun in the sun. What could go wrong?

films.title: The Bay
films.synopsis: Two best friends, Emma and Lani, attending a destination wedding in Thailand, find themselves trapped on a sinking tour boat in the heart of a tiger shark sanctuary.

films.title: Mandaadi
films.synopsis: A fishing captain applies his maritime knowledge in a traditional boat race along Tamil Nadu's coast during a festival, leading a six-person team against other crews.

films.title: America America 2
films.synopsis: A journey to Seattle brings Nudi face-to-face with her past. As old feelings resurface, she must navigate tested relationships and difficult choices between her current life and new possibilities. A story of love and second chances.

films.title: Runner
films.synopsis: A former soldier is thrown into a brutal race against time when a critical medical delivery makes him the target of a ruthless cartel. With betrayal closing in from every side, he must survive the chase and deliver his cargo before an innocent child runs out of time.

films.title: Epic
films.synopsis: Indian students navigating higher education, friendships, and the emotional highs and lows of young love while living abroad in the UK

films.title: Singh Vs Kaur 2
films.synopsis: Nehal, son of a martyred Army soldier, dreams of transforming his Punjab village. With his friend Tari, he convinces villagers to invest in a fish-farming project, but their money is stolen, leaving Nehal branded a fraud. His search leads to Canada, where he discovers Jasneet was forced into the crime after her brother was kidnapped by a drug syndicate. Together, they battle the criminals, recover the money, and restore Nehal’s honor and his father’s legacy.

films.title: The Uprising
films.synopsis: In plague-ravaged 14th-Century England, a peasant triggers a rebellion against King Richard II and unintentionally becomes a legend of resistance.

films.title: Aasha
films.synopsis: A Psychological thriller with intense visuals and a gripping story set in green, natural locations.

films.title: Donga Naa Koduku
films.synopsis: A robbery crime comedy centered around a jewellery shop heist that goes hilariously wrong.

films.title: Behulii
films.synopsis: Behuli is an emotional family drama about a young woman who lacks the support of her family. She dreams of finding a loving husband who will cherish her, help her build a beautiful life, and give her the freedom to live on her own terms.

films.title: Just Play Dead
films.synopsis: A criminal mastermind (Samuel L. Jackson) plans to fake his death for insurance money while framing his wife's lover. His wife (Eva Green) plots to kill him for real and take it all. Both race to outmaneuver each other in a deadly battle of wits.

films.title: Pradhama Drishtya Kuttakkar
films.synopsis: Follows a woman constable who joins the police force through appointment after the death of her husband.

films.title: Pressure
films.synopsis: In the tense 72 hours before D-Day, and with the fate of the free world hanging in the balance, Pressure follows General Dwight D. Eisenhower and Captain James Stagg as they face an impossible choice—launch the largest and most dangerous seaborne invasion in history or risk losing the war altogether.

films.title: Resident Evil
films.synopsis: From the mind of visionary filmmaker Zach Cregger (Weapons, Barbarian) comes a thrilling — and terrifying — reinvention of the Resident Evil franchise. In an all-new story, Resident Evil follows Bryan (Austin Abrams), a medical courier who unwittingly finds himself in an action-packed, non-stop race for survival as one fateful, horrifying night collapses around him in chaos.

films.title: Sunray: Fallen Soldier
films.synopsis: Sunray is a riveting revenge story following a group of combat veterans on a quest to uncover the truth behind a drug dealer's role in the tragic death of protagonist Andy's daughter.

films.title: Tad and the Magic Lamp
films.synopsis: Oli, Tad’s intrepid two-year-old daughter, has turned him into an overprotective father and Mummy feels sidelined by the attention she gets. When they find the magic lamp in Buckingham Palace, Mummy asks it to travel back in time to Paititi, Peru, in 1502. Tad, Sara and the whole team will have to follow Mummy into the past, before he changes history… Their journey will take them across the Atlantic Ocean from Peru to Greece, and from there deep into the Middle East, all the way to the cave of Ali Baba and the Forty Thieves.

films.title: Daayra
films.synopsis: Inspired by true events, Daayra is a gripping investigative thriller that follows DCP Raman Kumar and DCP Ajooni Kohli as a controversial case places them on opposing sides of the same system. As their paths collide, the film examines truth, accountability and the moral boundaries of justice, leaving the audience to confront the questions at its heart.

films.title: Daayra
films.synopsis: Inspired by true events, Daayra is a gripping investigative thriller that follows DCP Raman Kumar and DCP Ajooni Kohli as a controversial case places them on opposing sides of the same system. As their paths collide, the film examines truth, accountability and the moral boundaries of justice, leaving the audience to confront the questions at its heart.

films.title: The Weight
films.synopsis: Desperate to save what is left of his family, during the height of the Great Depression a battle-scarred veteran is hired to help smuggle a fortune in gold across 100 miles of impenetrable wilderness.

films.title: It's a Medical Miracle
films.synopsis: After being declared brain-dead, a lonely young man miraculously wakes up with an extraordinary gift of he can hear everything. As he searches for the nurse whose voice keeps him alive, he gets pulled into a haunting game of masks, memories, and revenge, where every sound could be a clue.. or a trap.

films.title: Law & Order
films.synopsis: After losing his son to a deadly drug empire, DYSP Balagopal joins forces with four fearless young recruits to wage a war against the ruthless Pacha and his cartel. As the streets erupt in blood and vengeance, the return of legendary gangster Karayackamuri Shanmughan (Mammootty) sets the stage for an explosive final showdown.

films.title: Mitti De Putt
films.synopsis: Two villages are bound by a rivalry that has outlived the men who started it. For one young man, the feud stops being history the day his uncle murders his grandparents and carries his mother away. Left with nothing but the land beneath his feet and the promise he makes on it, he sets out to answer blood with blood. To bring his mother home, he must first confront the man who took her, and the price the soil demands is heavier than he knows.

films.title: Vibe
films.synopsis: Mumbai, 2023. Bhagirath “Bugs” Bhargav is a sincere software engineer whose orderly life is constantly disrupted by his reckless yet lovable best friend, Hardik Sharma. Hoping to help him turn over a new leaf, Bugs gets Hardik a job at his company, where an unexpected romance begins to bloom. But when a high-stakes intelligence operation collides with their ordinary lives, the two friends are thrust into a world of espionage, deception, and escalating chaos. Completely out of their depth, Bugs and Hardik must survive a mission they were never meant to be part of—because sometimes, the fate of a nation rests in the most unlikely hands.

films.title: Butterfly Effect Azzam
films.synopsis: The film follows the introverted, screen-addicted Azzam as he passes through a portal of light into the vast "World of Butterflies". It is a coming-of-age adventure that explores themes of patriotism, courage, and the pursuit of happiness following the loss of his father, all within a thrilling comedic framework.

films.title: Avengers Endgame: Encore
films.synopsis: After the devastating events of Avengers: Infinity War (2018), the universe is in ruins. With the help of remaining allies, the Avengers assemble once more in order to reverse Thanos' actions and restore balance to the universe.

films.title: The Paradise
films.synopsis: In 1980s Secunderabad, a marginalized tribe battles discrimination and fights for citizenship under an unexpected leader's guidance, challenging systemic oppression.

films.title: The Smurfs Timeless Adventure Volume 2
films.synopsis: Join the Smurfs in a collection of fun-filled adventures packed with wild inventions, thrilling competitions, teamwork, and chaotic missions. From sports contests to hilarious encounters with Gargamel, the Smurfs discover that friendship and courage always save the day.

films.title: Crawlers
films.synopsis: Produced by John Wick’s Basil Iwanyk,  a catastrophic infestation of deadly spiders sends an apartment building into lockdown. Trapped inside by a police-mandated quarantine, building manager Serena (Matilda Lutz) and her residents battle to survive as the creatures multiply by the second. Serena may be the only one who can keep them alive--if she can confront her deepest fear.

films.title: The Vvaan: Force of the Forrest
films.synopsis: A rational urban man defies his ancestral village's forbidden forest and awakens a divine goddess, forcing him to confront powers beyond logic as he becomes the unlikely saviour protecting his people from annihilation.

films.title: Avengers Endgame: Encore (Infinity Vision)
films.synopsis: After the devastating events of Avengers: Infinity War (2018), the universe is in ruins. With the help of remaining allies, the Avengers assemble once more in order to reverse Thanos' actions and restore balance to the universe.

films.title: Dhoomakethu
films.synopsis: Dhoomakethu is an upcoming Malayalam time-loop comedy

films.title: Heart of the Beast
films.synopsis: After a harrowing plane crash, Special Forces officer James Belmont (Brad Pitt) and his combat dog, Odin, find themselves stranded deep in the Alaskan wilderness. Together, they are forced into a brutal fight for survival against the elements. From acclaimed filmmaker David Ayer, Heart of the Beast is an intense adventure thriller that explores the unbreakable bond between a man and his best friend as they face their greatest battle yet.

films.title: Tutt Paini English Ne
films.synopsis: Set in a Punjabi village, two families are divided by ego, education and the language they speak. Driven by comparison, Rupinder Kaur brings home an English-speaking daughter-in-law, Gagan, to prove her family's status. But Gagan is hiding a truth. She does not know a word of English. As the lie grows heavier, the pretending starts to crack the very relationships it was meant to impress, building to an emotional reckoning about who they really are.

films.title: Anbil Avan
films.synopsis: A young couple chasing a fresh start in the hills soon find their new life disrupted by a series of unsettling incidents that threaten everything they’ve worked for.

films.title: Verity
films.synopsis: Adapted from Colleen Hoover's best-selling novel, this seductive, psychological thriller follows renowned author Verity Crawford (Anne Hathaway) and Lowen Ashleigh (Dakota Johnson), a struggling writer who relocates to the remote Crawford estate to ghostwrite for Verity. After Lowen uncovers what appears to be Verity's chilling autobiographical notes, she wrestles with the disturbing and twisted confessions about Verity’s husband Jeremy (Josh Hartnett) - struggling to separate fiction from reality, manipulation from attraction, and opportunity from obsession.

films.title: Digger
films.synopsis: The most powerful man in the world embarks on a frantic mission to prove he is humanity’s saviour before the disaster he’s unleashed destroys everything.

films.title: Mr. Bhaarath
films.synopsis: An innocent young man with a unique outlook on life struggles to find love. Determined to see him settled, his elder brother helps him find a bride, leading to an unexpected romance that blossoms beyond expectations.

films.title: Wake
films.synopsis: Lake Reed is an actress with a string of lackluster accomplishments. After blowing countless auditions, her agent threatens to drop her if she does not land a role. Her eyes are set on the lead role in a major classic movie remake.

films.title: The Crystal Planet
films.synopsis: From Academy Award winners Jeremy Irons and Vanessa Redgrave comes an unforgettable animated adventure! On a newly colonized world, a young girl and a dinosaur-like cub must rely on friendship and courage to protect everything they love.

films.title: Gator Face
films.synopsis: When a group of friends becomes stranded in the Florida backwoods, they stumble upon a murderous swamp cult that sacrifices its victims to an alligator god—and must survive both its masked enforcer and the deadly creatures lurking in the dark.

films.title: Prem Keetanu
films.synopsis: Set against the chaotic charm of UP and NCR (Delhi–Gurgaon), the film blends humour, romance, and nostalgia. The narrative is elevated by a vibrant soundtrack that perfectly complements every mood—college madness, first love, heartbreak, and the bittersweet journey of figuring life out. This rom com is a relatable, entertaining ride about finding love, finding yourself, and laughing through the messiness of growing up.

films.title: Don't Trouble The Trouble
films.synopsis: Suri, a quirky street magician in Hyderabad who accidentally casts a spell that makes a young girl disappear, only to discover she is a powerful genie

films.title: Psycho
films.synopsis:
When a ruthless highway bandit known for his brutal killings resurfaces after years on the run, an ordinary traveler becomes the only witness to his crimes.
Wrongly accused by the police and hunted by a merciless psychopath, he must clear his name, save a young woman from captivity, and stop a killer before more innocent lives are lost.

films.title: SB19 Wakas at Simula: Trilogy Concert
films.synopsis:
From the Philippines to the world, SB19's historic Wakas at Simula: The Trilogy Concert Finale comes to cinemas worldwide.
Captured before a record breaking crowd of nearly 100,000 fans, the film showcases the group's biggest hits, spectacular production, and world class performances that have made SB19 one of Asia's most influential acts.
Presented in SCREENX and 4DX, audiences can experience the scale, sound, and energy of the concert like never before.
Experience the power of GENTO, What?, and DAM as the Philippines' biggest pop phenomenon takes over the big screen in an unforgettable celebration of music, fandom, and legacy.
More than a concert film, it is the story of a movement—one built by five artists, millions of fans, and a dream that helped redefine Filipino music for a new generation.

films.title: Beware Bouina
films.synopsis: A team of doctors embarks on a local mission in the Amazon rain forest, but it soon becomes clear that not everybody - or everything - is happy to see them. Their arrival draws the attention of a giant ancient predator, dominant on land and water, who emerges to reclaim the jungle.

films.title: The Florist
films.synopsis: A quiet horticulturalist harboring a secret life as a lethal assassin finds his true identity jeopardized when he forms an unlikely friendship with a witnesses to police corruption.

films.title: Street Fighter
films.synopsis: Set in 1993, estranged Street Fighters Ryu (Andrew Koji) and Ken Masters (Noah Centineo) are thrown back into combat when the mysterious Chun-Li (Callina Liang) recruits them for the next World Warrior Tournament: a brutal clash of fists, fate, and fury. But behind this battle royale lies a deadly conspiracy that forces them to face off against each other and the demons of their past. And if they don’t, it’s GAME OVER!

films.title: The Dino Family
films.synopsis: Phil is an ordinary teenager whose life is overshadowed by personal failures, schoolyard teasing, and the struggles of trying to impress his crush. Everything changes dramatically when he stumbles upon and accidentally opens a hidden portal to go back 65 million years.

films.title: Whalefall
films.synopsis: Follows a scuba diver who, while looking for his father's remains, is swallowed by an 80-foot, 60-ton sperm whale and has just one hour to get out before his oxygen runs out.

films.title: Clayface
films.synopsis: “Clayface” unravels one man’s horrifying descent from rising Hollywood star to revenge-filled monster in a story that explores the loss of one’s identity and humanity, corrosive love, and the dark underbelly of scientific ambition.

films.title: Klara and the Sun
films.synopsis: Based on the bestselling novel from Nobel Prize-winner Kazuo Ishiguro and written and directed by Academy-Award® winner Taika Waititi (Jojo Rabbit), Klara and the Sun introduces audiences to Klara (Jenna Ortega), an Artificial Friend who wants nothing more than to find the perfect home. When Klara meets Josie (Mia Tharia), each immediately senses a kindred spirit in the other. Josie has a fraught relationship with her mother (Amy Adams) and they’ve suffered great loss, but Klara’s innocent wonder and unwavering loyalty begin to heal the family and bring light to Josie’s complicated world.

films.title: The Mongoose
films.synopsis: Accused of a crime he didn't commit and with nothing to lose, a war hero (Liam Neeson) leads law enforcement on a cross-country car chase with the help of his brothers in arms and a sympathetic public rooting for his getaway.

films.title: BTS WORLD TOUR 'ARIRANG' IN BUENOS AIRES: LIVE
films.synopsis:
The first-ever BTS Live Viewing broadcast from South America.
Experience the BTS WORLD TOUR 'ARIRANG' in cinemas worldwide, broadcasting from
Buenos Aires, Argentina!
Marking the first time the band has ever performed in Argentina, this monumental
concert will bring the explosive energy of the packed stadium straight to the big screen.
Please note that broadcasts in some territories are scheduled later to accommodate
local time zones.

films.title: BTS WORLD TOUR 'ARIRANG' IN SÃO PAULO: LIVE
films.synopsis:
Experience the BTS WORLD TOUR 'ARIRANG' in cinemas worldwide, broadcasting from
São Paulo, Brazil!
Marking the grand finale of their Latin America tour, this monumental concert will bring
the explosive energy of the packed stadium in Brazil straight to the big screen.
Please note that broadcasts in some territories are scheduled later to accommodate
local time zones.

films.title: The Cat In The Hat
films.synopsis: Meet the Cat in the Hat you don’t know! In the wonderfully whimsical tradition of Dr. Seuss, The Cat in the Hat comes to the big screen in his animated theatrical feature film debut, an all-new, epic adventure with an edge, where mischief, magic and mayhem reign supreme.

films.title: The Draw
films.synopsis: Alec lives under a repressive society that monitors his every movement, while working at the central avatar store — a symbol of the EyeLight technological revolution he viscerally resists. His isolation is disrupted by Jade, an equally rebellious figure who plays the system far more strategically. Their unfolding forbidden relationship will push both of them to the very brink.

films.title: Les Misérables
films.synopsis: An epic new take on Victor Hugo's timeless classic.

films.title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
films.synopsis: THE HUNGER GAMES: SUNRISE ON THE REAPING revisits the world of Panem and follows young Haymitch Abernathy (Joseph Zada) twenty-four years before the events of The Hunger Games, starting on the morning of the reaping of the Fiftieth Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell.

films.title: Focker In-Law
films.synopsis:
This November, comedy icon and Emmy winner Ben Stiller and two-time Oscar® winner Robert De Niro reunite, joined by Grammy winner and Oscar® nominee Ariana Grande, in Focker-In-Law, a new chapter in the blockbuster Meet the Parents franchise.

Written and directed by John Hamburg, who co-wrote the three previous Meet the Parents films, Focker-In-Law is produced by Oscar® nominee Jane Rosenthal and Robert De Niro for Tribeca Productions; Ben Stiller and Oscar® winner John Lesher for Red Hour Films.

films.title: Hexed
films.synopsis: An awkward teen and her Type-A mother learn her peculiarities might be magical powers, transforming their lives and revealing a hidden magical realm.

films.title: Violent Night 2
films.synopsis:
If you’re nice, you get presents from the Big Guy. If you’re naughty, you get justice.
 
But when Santa forgets the true meaning of Christmas, he finds himself in the heart of a lively mall community in desperate need of his help. Sapped of his magic, he’ll need another way to take on the goons threatening the mall, and time is running out. Santa has to rediscover his faith in goodness and call in some last-minute reinforcements from the one person no baddie wants to tangle with: Mrs. Claus.

films.title: Avengers: Doomsday
films.synopsis: Heroes from three different worlds must unite when they're thrust together to confront a catastrophic danger that could destroy everything they know.

films.title: Dune: Part Three
films.synopsis: Dune: Part Three is based on the novel Dune Messiah by Frank Herbert and delivers the epic conclusion to Villeneuve’s trilogy.

films.title: Voice Message
films.synopsis: Seeking answers about her family's tragedy, Naya receives messages from beyond through her sister Anna's final voice note. What begins as an attempt to reconnect with the spirit turns into a spiral of terror: the same entity that possessed Anna now seeks Naya as its new host, leading both siblings on a descent into madness, where the line between the living and the dead disappears.

films.title: Children of Blood and Bone
films.synopsis: In the epic fantasy world of Orïsha, a young woman goes on a quest to reclaim the magic that was violently stolen from her people. She and her brother ally with the daughter and son of the king to fight back against his brutal rule. Directed by Gina Prince-Bythewood, CHILDREN OF BLOOD AND BONE features a stellar cast including Thuso Mbedu, Damson Idris, Amandla Stenberg, Tosin Cole, featuring Academy Award® nominee Cynthia Erivo, Lashana Lynch, Zackary Momoh, Richard Mofe-Damijo, Academy Award®  nominee Chiwetel Ejiofor, Academy Award®  winner Regina King, with Idris Elba and Academy Award®  winner Viola Davis.

films.title: Cocomelon: The Movie
films.synopsis: When JJ starts kindergarten, his first big day takes an unexpected turn after his beloved teddy bear, Boba, goes missing. Joined by his friends Cody, CeCe and Nina, JJ embarks on a magical adventure to the Kingdom of Melody, where singing has been forbidden by Princess Harmony. Along the way, the friends discover the power of courage, friendship and finding their own voices. Featuring ten brand-new songs, CoComelon: The Movie brings the beloved world of CoComelon to the big screen in an all-new musical adventure for the whole family.

films.title: Gatto
films.synopsis: Indebted to a feline mob boss, a black cat named Nero finds himself forced to forge an unexpected friendship that may finally lead him to his purpose.
